verdict.rationale: ADK ships a built-in evaluation framework with ground-truth and rubric-based tool-use metrics, expected tool-call trajectory checks, and session-level test files positioned as unit tests. A scriptable `adk eval` CLI runs eval sets against an agent, which makes running them in a pipeline plausible. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of CI integration (e.g., pytest/CI pipeline setup or pass/fail thresholds), and independent or hands-on corroboration of eval-in-CI workflows.
